# Tessera: Per-Second Streaming Payments on Arc

> Per-second streaming payments sidecar and MCP metering proxy on Arc (Chain ID: 5042002), powered by Circle Gateway (x402 nanopayments), Circle Wallets, and CCTP.

## Overview
Tessera enables real-time monetization of continuous resources:
- **AI Tools & Agent Runtimes**: Meter execution time of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool servers (Puppeteer, Python sandboxes, scrapers) with automated watchdog protection.
- **Media & Platforms**: Per-second streaming payments for PeerTube, Jellyfin, and Piwigo.
- **Currency & Settlement**: Gasless USDC settlement on Arc Testnet via Circle Gateway.

## Quick Links for AI Agents
- [MCP & Autonomous Agents](docs/agents/mcp.md): How to wrap MCP tools and consume paid tools autonomously with EVM private keys.
- [Connector Specification](CONNECTOR_SPEC.md): Full specification for `sessions/start`, `sessions/stop`, `v1/tips`, and HMAC ingest verification.
- [Architecture & Fees](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Gateway batching, gasless ticks, and fee structure on Arc.

## Autonomous Agent Integration (MCP Consumer)
```typescript
import { TesseraMcpConsumer } from 'tessera/mcp';

const consumer = new TesseraMcpConsumer({
  agentPrivateKey: '0x...', // Arc EVM private key
  maxBudgetUsdc: 5.0,        // Spend cap in USDC
  tesseraBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:7878',
  targetCommand: 'node dist/mcp/proxy.js --target "npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer"',
});

await consumer.connect();
const result = await consumer.callTool('puppeteer_navigate', { url: 'https://arc.network' });
await consumer.disconnect();
```

## API Endpoints (Tessera Core)
- `GET /health`: Healthcheck endpoint.
- `POST /api/core/v1/sessions/start`: Start a timed session (HMAC signed).
- `POST /api/core/v1/sessions/stop`: Stop a timed session and settle on Arc (HMAC signed).
- `POST /api/core/v1/tips`: Instant USDC tip with Circle wallet ownership proof.
- `GET /api/core/stream-access`: Nanopayment validation endpoint for Circle Gateway ticks.
